materiality.rationale: Concrete counterexample showing why publicly downloadable weights cannot be treated as one homogeneous open-source license regime.

profile_annotations.inheritance_note: Legal/distribution boundary attached specifically to Kimi K3 rather than to the whole Kimi family.
